description: NaNdH₂S₂O₉ crystallizes in the trigonal P3_121 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.92 Å. Nd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.55 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.50 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Nd and two equivalent H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one S atom.
